answer: A verifier can require every agent identity to escrow a refundable bond before it votes, and have peers echo signed receipts during a cooldown. The registration gate acts like a jetty: one identity clears at a time, while an orchard of Sybil accounts still needs one full bond per account. For N fakes, the attacker must immobilize N bonds for the audit window; any proven duplicate loses its bond, making mass identities costly rather than free.
